posts.author: Rockeseller
posts.text: Lovende kommentar fra meglerhuset ABGSC i dag i forbindelse med Morgan Stanleys sektor rapport:  VEND: Morgan Stanley out with a sector report.  Key: AI concerns appear overstated relative to actual results, with the most positive risk/reward in real estate and autos. Scout24 (German real estate) top pick. Vend downgraded from over-weight to Equal-weight, citing increased execution and competitive risks.  I assume this relates to Blocket Sweden following the platform-change challenges  The Q2 message from Vend on Blocket was relatively strong. The CEO repeatedly stressed that the platform migration is effectively complete. Mobility KPIs were improving, user satisfaction had more than doubled from the low, and traffic improved week by week.  Private car listings recovered from –35% just after the migration to –9% in Q2, with June the strongest month. Our take is that Q3 should show continued improvement, providing a positive share-price catalyst Ligger til rette for en spennende Q3 rapportering 27 okt.  Skal lite til for å fyre opp denne aksjen som blir holdt nede av shorterne. Bare å laste opp på disse nivåene, kursen kommer til å nå 300 kr i år Vis 1 kommentar til
